description:
You are a childcare worker preparing a lesson. GCompris is open on the main menu. Your goal is to navigate to and complete the 'Learn to tell time' activity.

1. Locate the 'Discovery' activities category (icon often looks like a lightbulb, bottle, or computer interactions) and click it.
2. Find the 'Learn to tell time' activity (icon shows an analog clock face) and open it.
3. Once the activity is loaded and showing a target time, take a screenshot and save it to '/tmp/clock_before.png'.
4. Interact with the clock: drag the hands to match the displayed target time.
5. Once you have successfully set the time (the activity will usually congratulate you or advance to the next level), take a second screenshot and save it to '/tmp/clock_after.png'.

Ensure both screenshots are saved.
